<!DOCTYPE html>



    
    
    Terminal —  / 

    
    
    
    

    



    

        

             / 
        
        Connecting…
    

    


    

        Establishing SSH connection…
        —
    

    
        var odoo = ;

        (function () {
            var SESSION_ID   = '';
            var CSRF         = odoo.csrf_token;
            var POLL_MS      = 80;
            var IDLE_WARN_S  = 90;   // show warning this many seconds before timeout
            var TIMEOUT_S    = 120;  // must match SESSION_TIMEOUT on the server

            var badge      = document.getElementById('conn-badge');
            var statusText = document.getElementById('status-text');
            var sizeText   = document.getElementById('size-text');

            // ── xterm.js ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
            var term = new Terminal({
                cursorBlink: true,
                fontSize: 13,
                fontFamily: "'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Mono', Consolas, monospace",
                theme: {
                    background: '#1e1e1e',
                    foreground: '#d4d4d4',
                    cursor: '#60b8e0',
                },
                allowProposedApi: true,
            });

            var fitAddon = new FitAddon.FitAddon();
            term.loadAddon(fitAddon);
            term.open(document.getElementById('terminal-container'));
            fitAddon.fit();

            function updateSizeText() {
                sizeText.textContent = term.cols + '×' + term.rows;
            }
            updateSizeText();

            // ── JSON-RPC helper ───────────────────────────────────────────
            function rpc(path, params) {
                return fetch(path, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-Csrf-Token': CSRF,
                    },
                    credentials: 'same-origin',
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        jsonrpc: '2.0', method: 'call', id: Date.now(), params: params,
                    }),
                }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (r) { return r.result; });
            }

            // ── Base64 helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────
            function b64ToUint8(b64) {
                var bin = atob(b64);
                var arr = new Uint8Array(bin.length);
                for (var i = 0; i < bin.length; i++) arr[i] = bin.charCodeAt(i);
                return arr;
            }

            function uint8ToB64(arr) {
                var bin = '';
                arr.forEach(function (b) { bin += String.fromCharCode(b); });
                return btoa(bin);
            }

            // ── Input → server ────────────────────────────────────────────
            term.onData(function (data) {
                var encoded = uint8ToB64(new TextEncoder().encode(data));
                rpc('/cloud/terminal/' + SESSION_ID + '/input', { data: encoded }).catch(function () {});
            });

            term.onBinary(function (data) {
                var arr = new Uint8Array(data.length);
                for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i++) arr[i] = data.charCodeAt(i) & 255;
                rpc('/cloud/terminal/' + SESSION_ID + '/input', { data: uint8ToB64(arr) }).catch(function () {});
            });

            // ── Resize ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
            var _resizeTimer = null;
            function onResize() {
                clearTimeout(_resizeTimer);
                _resizeTimer = setTimeout(function () {
                    fitAddon.fit();
                    updateSizeText();
                    rpc('/cloud/terminal/' + SESSION_ID + '/resize', {
                        cols: term.cols, rows: term.rows,
                    }).catch(function () {});
                }, 100);
            }
            window.addEventListener('resize', onResize);

            // ── Output polling ────────────────────────────────────────────
            var afterSeq    = 0;
            var polling     = true;
            var paused      = false;  // true when tab is hidden

            function setBadge(cls, text) {
                badge.className = 'terminal-badge ' + cls;
                badge.textContent = text;
            }

            function onClosed(reason) {
                polling = false;
                setBadge('closed', 'Closed');
                if (reason === 'timeout') {
                    var msg = '\r\n\x1b[33m⏱  Session closed due to inactivity. Open a new terminal to reconnect.\x1b[0m\r\n';
                    term.write(new TextEncoder().encode(msg));
                    statusText.textContent = 'Session expired (idle timeout).';
                } else {
                    statusText.textContent = 'Session closed.';
                }
            }

            function poll() {
                if (paused) {
                    setTimeout(poll, 500);
                    return;
                }
                rpc('/cloud/terminal/' + SESSION_ID + '/output', { after_seq: afterSeq })
                    .then(function (result) {
                        if (!result) return;

                        if (result.connected && badge.className.indexOf('connected') === -1) {
                            setBadge('connected', 'Connected');
                            statusText.textContent = 'Connected';
                        }

                        (result.chunks || []).forEach(function (chunk) {
                            afterSeq = Math.max(afterSeq, chunk.seq);
                            term.write(b64ToUint8(chunk.data));
                        });

                        // Idle warning
                        var idle = result.idle_seconds || 0;
                        var remaining = TIMEOUT_S - idle;
                        if (!result.closed && !result.error && remaining <= IDLE_WARN_S) {
                            setBadge('idle', 'Idle ' + Math.ceil(remaining) + 's');
                            statusText.textContent = 'Closing in ' + Math.ceil(remaining) + 's due to inactivity — press any key to reset.';
                        } else if (result.connected && !result.closed && !result.error) {
                            // Restore badge if idle cleared
                            if (badge.className.indexOf('idle') !== -1) {
                                setBadge('connected', 'Connected');
                                statusText.textContent = 'Connected';
                            }
                        }

                        if (result.error) {
                            polling = false;
                            setBadge('error', 'Error');
                            statusText.textContent = 'Error: ' + result.error;
                        } else if (result.closed) {
                            onClosed(result.close_reason);
                        }
                    })
                    .catch(function () {
                        statusText.textContent = 'Connection error — retrying…';
                    })
                    .finally(function () {
                        if (polling) setTimeout(poll, POLL_MS);
                    });
            }

            poll();

            // ── Pause when tab is hidden, resume when visible ─────────────
            document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
                if (document.hidden) {
                    paused = true;
                    if (badge.className.indexOf('closed') === -1 &&
                        badge.className.indexOf('error') === -1) {
                        setBadge('paused', 'Paused');
                    }
                } else {
                    paused = false;
                    // Restore badge if we were connected
                    if (badge.className.indexOf('paused') !== -1) {
                        setBadge('connected', 'Connected');
                        statusText.textContent = 'Connected';
                    }
                }
            });

            // ── Cleanup on page close ─────────────────────────────────────
            window.addEventListener('beforeunload', function () {
                polling = false;
                fetch('/cloud/terminal/' + SESSION_ID + '/close', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Csrf-Token': CSRF },
                    keepalive: true,
                    body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', method: 'call', id: 0, params: {} }),
                });
            });
        })();
